changelog:
Initial release of "Google Sheets Append Row" skill.

- Enables appending up to one row at a time to a Google Sheet via the gog CLI.
- Provides a standardized command for adding values to a specified range.
- Incorporates autonomous error reporting through CLI feedback.
- Designed as a minimal, atomic node focused on single-task efficiency.
summary: Atomic node skill to append a row in Google Sheets using the gog CLI.
